data.description:
#### **Main info:**
- `[Trix]` -> that's me (@nekotrix), join [![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=discord.com) AV1 weeb edition](https://discord.gg/83dRFDFDp7)
`Sparks of Tomorrow` -> anime title, info on [![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=anidb.net) AniDB](https://anidb.net/anime/20023), [![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=myanimelist.net) MyAnimeList](https://myanimelist.net/anime/64012), [![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=anilist.co) AniList](https://anilist.co/anime/211308), [![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=thetvdb.com) TheTVDB](https://www.thetvdb.com/series/the-ribbon-hero-ribonhiro)
- `WEB-DL` -> Remux of [![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=nyaa.si) Tsundere-Raws](https://nyaa.si/user/Tsundere-Raws)' NF AV1 source with [![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=nyaa.si) ToonsHub](https://nyaa.si/?f=0&c=0_0&q=ToonsHub)'s English dub and subtitle options
`1080p` -> video resolution (1920x1080 @ 23.976 FPS)
`AV1` -> 📺 video format (Main + 4:2:0 + 10-bit = hardware friendly)
`Opus` -> 🔊 audio format (Stereo 2.0 @ 128kbps)
- `Dual Audio` -> 🔊 dual audio tracks (three actually eheh): **Japanese 🇯🇵, English 🇺🇸 & French 🇫🇷**
`Multi Subs` -> 📄 multiple subtitles tracks including: **English, English (Forced), English (SDH), English (Dubtitles), French, French (Forced), French (Dubtitle), Arabic, Spanish (Latin America), Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Czech, Danish, Dutch, Filipino, Finnish, Greek, Hebrew, Croatian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Japanese (SDH), Korean, Malay, Norwegian Bokmål, Polish, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese**
`VOSTFR` -> keyword to denote the presence of french subtitles

***
#### **Misc info:**
> **Direct Download Link:** [DDL](https://gofile.io/d/0Adkgd) (GoFile)

*Note:* The only changes over the mentionned sources are that English subtitles were restyled, and all audio were converted from 640kbps E-AC3 5.1 to 128kbps Opus 2.0.

**Language Options**
You can [download here](https://mega.nz/folder/kcQhWZCA#c4wfvx2RXI9XN8XeBso09g) two scripts that do the following (Windows/macOS-Linux):

- *Keep Japanese*: Throws out all audio tracks other than Japanese
- *Keep English*: Throws out all audio and subtitles tracks other than English

Put all the video files into the *Language Options* folder and run the corresponding script. The resulting files can be found in the *output* folder.

Note: [MKVToolNix](https://mkvtoolnix.download/downloads.html) must be installed on your system

***
